cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've shut my trophy case like you. Mine wins for easy carrying. Can you lift yours with one hand?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I shut an empty case. My trophy's out for the winner's photograph; yours is the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, ready for display. How many shelves can your first prize fit on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One. The cabinet's made to hold the winner's cup in the middle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine wins for choice. Pick a shelf anywhere else in the room; I can put mine there.
